task.title: Pause and resume bounded paper sessions on manual Source freshness

owned_layer: Extracted pure, side-effect-free market snapshot admission rule in services/execution/market_snapshot_admission.py shared by producer and reconciler.
Atomic metadata_patch support on RuntimeBindingStore.transition_status and RuntimeManagerService.transition for structured session_admission metadata.
Paper fleet reconciler stale detection transitioning active -> pending_pause -> paused with session_admission metadata and terminating worker process.
Paper fleet reconciler manual resume transitioning paused -> active and starting worker only on newer, distinct admitted snapshot.
Prohibition of auto-resuming operator manual pauses.
Comprehensive positive and negative test suites in test_paper_fleet_reconciler.py, test_runtime_binding.py, and test_paper_signal_producer.py.
not_changing: No new RuntimeBindingStatus (reused existing active, pending_pause, paused state machine without paused_stale_input).
No separate paper-session table or secondary state store.
No recurring background provider pulls (Source remains reconcile-only; reconciler and producer only query local snapshot endpoint).
No bypass of operator manual pause controls.

state_machine.idempotency: Repeated reconcile cycles on paused/stale bindings emit zero duplicate transitions and spawn zero workers.

admission_rule.function: admit_market_snapshot(snapshot, expected_symbol, max_age_seconds, minimum_closes, now_iso, binding_id)
admission_rule.returns: SnapshotAdmissionDecision(admitted=bool, snapshot_id, event_time, age_seconds, reason_code, detail)

results: 137 passed in 22.28s (56 reconciler tests, 57 runtime binding tests, 18 signal producer tests, 6 current artifact signal tests).
Positive test verified: fresh snapshot retains and starts exactly one active worker.
Positive test verified: stale snapshot transitions active -> pending_pause -> paused and stops worker.
Positive test verified: repeated stale reconciles are idempotent with zero duplicate transitions.
Positive test verified: new admitted snapshot with newer timestamp resumes paused binding once and starts worker.
Positive test verified: producer and reconciler return identical admission decisions.
Negative test verified: same stale snapshot cannot resume.
Negative test verified: older or same timestamp snapshot cannot resume.
Negative test verified: invalid, future (>300s), missing closes, or wrong symbol snapshot cannot resume.
Negative test verified: restart while paused stays paused and starts no worker.
Negative test verified: operator pause is never auto-resumed.
Negative test verified: zero recurring provider pull proof (reconciler and producer only query local snapshot endpoint).

review_decision.reviewer_action_required: Claude must independently inspect this committed manifest and exact task-branch head, rerun the test suites, verify state machine idempotency and pause/resume rules, and bind canonical approval with this review_file before merge.
